tickets.label: ENGINE-002 · Campaign registration
tickets.brief: ENGINE-002 is complete and merged. Retain this entry as scheduling history; do not start or resume it unless the owner explicitly requests a new follow-up ticket.

tickets.label: Roadmap · Scenario launch validation
tickets.brief: Start a fresh ticket for one bounded infrastructure change that adds a deterministic scenario launch/parse validation step after ENGINE-002. Preserve localhost-only and credential boundaries, avoid controlled reference changes, capture real engine exit evidence, and stop before publication approval.

tickets.label: Roadmap · Playable scenario skeleton
tickets.brief: Start a fresh ticket for one bounded game change: create the first playable scenario skeleton with a small original map, correctly declared sides and leaders, runtime objectives, and explicit victory/defeat flow. Reuse the registered campaign structure, avoid copyrighted prose or assets, and require applicable static and installed-engine checks.

tickets.label: Roadmap · Unit and faction foundation
tickets.brief: Start a fresh ticket for the smallest reviewable unit/faction foundation change: establish reusable baseline data structures and one representative original unit implementation without attempting the full roster. Keep mechanics deterministic, preserve campaign/core separation, and validate all changed WML with the applicable repository and engine gates.

tickets.label: Roadmap · Ranged-combat proof of concept
tickets.brief: Start a fresh ticket to define and implement one bounded ranged-combat proof of concept using native min_range/max_range support first, adding only the WML or Lua required to close a demonstrated UX or AI gap. Include a focused validation fixture or scenario and document any engine limitation discovered.

tickets.label: Roadmap · Cover and defense proof of concept
tickets.brief: Start a fresh ticket for one small proof-of-concept change for a readable cover or defensive mechanic using supported Wesnoth behavior. Implement only one representative interaction, keep it independent from campaign-specific content where practical, and include deterministic and engine-backed validation appropriate to the mechanic.

tickets.label: Roadmap · Off-map air-support prototype
tickets.brief: Start a fresh ticket to plan and execute the smallest safe off-map air-support prototype for a ground scenario. Represent the sortie as a bounded scripted support action rather than a persistent fast aircraft unit, use original content, make costs, targeting, and results legible, and validate one representative end-to-end interaction.

tickets.label: Roadmap · Space-scenario prototype
tickets.brief: Start a fresh ticket for one bounded space-scenario foundation change that proves a single tactical interaction such as screening, interception, escort, or survival. Avoid building the complete space system, use original assets and text only, keep the abstraction maintainable, and require a focused engine-backed scenario check.
